pre_condition: value can be any type; no constraints on its value.
post_condition: Returns True when value is of type str and contains at least one character that is not a whitespace character (according to Python's str.strip whitespace definition: spaces, tabs, newlines, carriage returns, vertical tabs, and form feeds). Returns False when value is not of type str, or when value is a str consisting entirely of zero or more whitespace characters with no non-whitespace content.
